decisions.reason: A simple accessory that builds directly on the firm's trailer and coupling know-how costs little to keep and supports after-sales revenue, so there is little reason to drop it.
The box trailer series is core to the firm's established production knowledge, and its home-page prominence signals strategic importance and good ability to interpret market feedback.
Car transporters extend the firm's chassis and axle expertise into a related professional niche, which the firm can assimilate and refine through its dealer and service network.
The low-bed series draws closely on existing trailer design and production skills, and its home-page placement indicates it is a featured line the firm will keep developing.
High covers are a natural complement to the firm's box trailers, use known materials and processes, and sell easily through existing channels.
This second box trailer series sits firmly within the firm's core competence, though overlap with Product B creates some risk that the two lines are consolidated.
